questions.title: Before we get started, what’s your full name?
And your email, {{field:7acc7644-998b-4603-9271-cc89960f6e01}}?
questions.description: We’ll use this to follow up.

questions.title: What’s your phone number?
questions.description: Enter your US phone number. We’ll add +1 automatically.

questions.title: Which best describes your current situation?
choices: I'm actively planning my move and need professional help
I'm seriously considering the Philippines but need guidance
I'm at an early stage and mainly looking for advice

questions.title: How committed are you to relocating to the Philippines?
questions.description: We work with expats who are serious about coming to the Philippines.
choices: Mostly committed - a few concerns left

questions.title: When do you plan to arrive in the Philippines?
questions.description: Please book a call only when you’re ready to use our relocation services.

questions.title: What brings you to the Philippines?
Which services do you need?
questions.description: We’re here to make your transition as smooth as possible. Tell us how we can help.

questions.title: What monthly budget do you expect to have once you’re settled in the Philippines?
questions.description: This helps us tailor our recommendations to your budget.

questions.title: Do you currently have liquid funds available to invest in relocation support — separate from savings tied to property, retirement accounts, or pending sales?
choices: I have the funds but they're tied up right now

questions.title: What arrangements do you still need to finalize before making the move?
questions.description: Please book a call only if you’re ready to use our relocation services without waiting for other arrangements to be finalized.
choices: None, I'm ready to get professional help now
I'm not ready to move forward, still finalizing logistics

questions.title: What is the biggest challenge you would need our help to overcome?
questions.description: We work with expats who want support throughout their move. Please book a call only if you’re interested in professional relocation help.

questions.title: What specifically made you want to speak with Evan or The Savvy Expat team?
questions.description: We value getting to know you and understanding what you’re looking for.

questions.title: Next, choose a time for your discovery call.
questions.description: We’ll talk through your plans for the Philippines and how our team can help. Choose an available time on the next page, then confirm your booking.

endings.timeline: Our relocation services are designed for people who are ready to plan their move. Please get back in touch when you’re closer to relocating to the Philippines. We’ll be here when the time is right.
endings.commitment: Our services are designed for people who have decided to come to the Philippines. If you’re still weighing your options, please get back in touch when you’re ready to move forward.
endings.situation: Our services are designed for people who are ready to plan their move and work with a relocation team. As your plans develop, please get back in touch. In the meantime, you can find more guidance on our YouTube channel.
endings.logistics: Thank you for your interest in The Savvy Expat. We work with people who are ready to use our relocation services. Please get back in touch once your remaining arrangements are settled and you’re ready to move forward.
